documents.title: Working around the 2,000-record Bulk Export limit
documents.content:
# Working around the 2,000-record Bulk Export limit

## Problem

The `BulkExportService.export()` method returns at most 2,000 records per call and raises `NIMBUS_LIMIT_EXCEEDED_0427` when the result set is larger.

## Workaround

Paginate manually using the `cursorToken` returned in the response header `X-Nimbus-Cursor`. Loop until the header is empty, appending each page to your output. A typical implementation wraps the loop in a `QueueableJob` so that each page runs in its own execution context.

## Applies to

This workaround is required on Winter '24, Spring '24 and Summer '24. It is superseded by Bulk Export API v2 in Winter '25; see the release note for that version.

documents.title: Bulk Export API v2 raises the per-call limit to 50,000 records
documents.content:
# Bulk Export API v2

Starting with Winter '25, `BulkExportService.export()` uses the v2 engine and returns up to 50,000 records per call.

## What changed

- The 2,000-record ceiling is removed.
- `NIMBUS_LIMIT_EXCEEDED_0427` is no longer raised for result sets under 50,000 records.
- The `X-Nimbus-Cursor` header is still emitted for backwards compatibility but manual pagination is no longer required for typical exports.

## Recommendation

Remove cursor-based pagination loops that were added as a workaround for the 2,000-record limit. Keeping them is harmless but adds unnecessary complexity and execution contexts.

documents.title: Async Trigger Framework
documents.content:
# Async Trigger Framework

Introduced in Spring '25. The Async Trigger Framework lets you annotate a trigger handler with `@AsyncTrigger` so that record changes are processed in a background queue instead of the synchronous save transaction.

## Usage

```
@AsyncTrigger(object='Order', events={'afterInsert','afterUpdate'})
public class OrderAsyncHandler implements AsyncTriggerHandler { ... }
```

## Limits

Up to 50 async handlers per object. Handlers run within 60 seconds of commit under normal load.

## Availability

This framework does not exist in releases before Spring '25. On earlier releases use `QueueableJob` enqueued from a synchronous trigger.

documents.title: LegacySyncCallout is deprecated as of Summer '24
documents.content:
# LegacySyncCallout deprecation

As of Summer '24, the `LegacySyncCallout.send()` API is deprecated. It continues to function but emits a `DEPRECATED_API_0912` warning in debug logs.

## Replacement

Use `HttpClient.sendAsync()` which supports retries and timeouts natively.

## Removal

No removal date has been announced. Code using `LegacySyncCallout` keeps working in Winter '25 and Spring '25 but should be migrated.

documents.title: Field History retention period
documents.content:
# Field History retention

Field History entries are retained for 18 months. Entries older than 18 months are purged by a nightly job and cannot be recovered. Use the `FieldHistoryArchive` add-on to retain data for longer.

documents.title: Field History retention period (updated)
documents.content:
# Field History retention (updated)

Field History entries are retained for 24 months. Entries older than 24 months are purged by a nightly job. The `FieldHistoryArchive` add-on extends retention beyond that window.

Note: this article was revised after the retention window was extended; the original publication date predates the change.

documents.title: Error reference: NIMBUS_LIMIT_EXCEEDED_0427
documents.content:
# NIMBUS_LIMIT_EXCEEDED_0427

**Message:** `Result set exceeds the maximum number of records for this operation.`

## Cause

Raised by `BulkExportService.export()` when the result set exceeds the per-call ceiling for the running release (2,000 records before Winter '25; 50,000 records from Winter '25 onward).

## Resolution

Narrow the query with a filter, or on releases before Winter '25 use cursor-based pagination.

documents.title: Scheduled job concurrency limits
documents.content:
# Scheduled job concurrency limits

An organisation can run at most 5 scheduled jobs concurrently. Jobs beyond the limit are queued and started when a slot frees up. Use `SchedulerService.getRunningCount()` to inspect the current count before enqueuing.

documents.title: Scheduled job concurrency limits
documents.content:
# Scheduled job concurrency limits

An organisation can run at most 10 scheduled jobs concurrently. Jobs beyond the limit are queued and started when a slot frees up. Use `SchedulerService.getRunningCount()` to inspect the current count before enqueuing.

documents.title: Retry pattern for UNABLE_TO_LOCK_ROW
documents.content:
# Retry pattern for UNABLE_TO_LOCK_ROW

When a DML statement fails with `UNABLE_TO_LOCK_ROW`, wrap the operation in a retry loop using `LockRetryUtil.withRetry(3)`. The utility re-issues the statement with exponential backoff.

## Compatibility

`LockRetryUtil` relies on synchronous trigger execution. It is not compatible with handlers registered through the Async Trigger Framework (Spring '25 and later), where the platform retries lock contention automatically.

documents.title: Community note: Platform Cache partition sizing
documents.content:
# Platform Cache partition sizing

A community member reports that `PlatformCache.put()` silently drops entries larger than 100 KB. Allocate at least 5 MB per partition for session cache. The release this applies to was not stated.
